title: Side project called MMA - MultiMind Arena (for group chats)
author: Horror-Apprehensive
selftext:
I'm thinking of developing a cool side project called MultiMind Arena that I think is pretty unique. 

It's a platform where multiple users can join different "arenas" to interact with AI-powered historical figures.

The cool part is these AIs play specific roles depending on the arena type:

* In debate arenas, they might be famous philosophers or leaders
* For games, they could be quiz masters or strategy experts , or just your favorite charachter from the game.
* There's even a dating arena where AIs take on personas of match-maker figures (bit quirky, I know)
* And of course! - Troll arenas, where you can engage in witty banter and wordplay with users and AI comedians and satirists

The idea is to create a space for group discussions, games, and unusual social experiences, all with an educational twist.

I've got some retro-matrix style designs done - think green on black, old-school tech vibes.

Looking for devs interested in helping build this out. If this sounds like your kind of project, drop me a message. Always keen to collaborate on something different.

Thoughts? Questions? Let me know!
